intro: Print templates for control points. Works without an open project as well.

apriltag.title: AprilTags (150 mm, tag36h11)
apriltag.hint: For indoor use: scale and optional georeferencing. Print at 100 %.

cross.title: Cross targets (180 mm, numbered)
cross.hint: For drone flights and outdoor use: two black triangles on white paper, tips = survey point. Lay the whole sheet, or the square cut out along the marks, flat on the ground. Works on light and dark ground.
